title.narrative: Ending Agricultural Bonded Labour in Nepal

description.narrative: The expected effects for the target groups of the project are threefold: Outcome 1: A united movement of agricultural bonded labour groups is formed and active at the national level; Outcome 2: The government changes policies to address agricultural bonded labour and provide support services for survivors; Outcome 3: Agricultural bonded labourers have greater resilience as a result of accessing government and NGO support services.

The projectâ€™s expected effect on society is significant reduction in the prevalence of agricultural bonded labour in Nepal with survivors accessing sustainable freedom. The intended target groups are agricultural bonded labourers and survivors from marginalised ethnic groups in Nepal.
